ratios.quote: an interest expense test that requires us to maintain an interest coverage ratio not less than 2.5 to 1 at the end of each fiscal quarter
an indebtedness test that requires us to maintain a consolidated net leverage ratio not greater than 3.5 to 1, subject to certain exceptions

parsed.notes: The filing does not disclose actual ratio values. It states only that the company was in compliance at 2026-09-30 and exceeded the financial covenant requirements by substantial margins. Interest coverage is Consolidated EBIT divided by Consolidated Interest Expense. Net leverage is Consolidated Net Debt divided by Consolidated EBITDA. The net leverage limit is subject to certain exceptions that are not specified. The consolidated leverage ratio is also used to set facility fees; that pricing use is not a separate covenant.
